Supreme Hive Control: While this model is on the tabletop, at the start of your Command Phase, select one of the following to be in effect for all Tyranids units on the battlefield with at least 1 model within Synapse Range of this model:

  • Frenzy: Attacks gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability, or increase [X] by 1 if the attack already possesses the Sustained Hits [X] ability.
  • Onslaught: Units gain the Relentless ability if they do not already possess it. Units that already possess the Relentless ability increase the distance they can Advance by 2"
  • Adaptive Reflexes: Units gain the Unyielding ability.

Tactical Instincts: While this model is on the tabletop, this model can use this ability during your Command Phase. To do so, select 1 of the following to be in effect until the end of the Battle Round for 1 Tyranid unit (including its own unit) on the battlefield with at least 1 model within Synapse Range of this model:

  • Target Obliteration: Models in the selected unit score Critical Hits on a 4+ for either Ranged or Melee attacks when every model attacks the same enemy unit.
  • Linchpin: Select an enemy Character model within 24" of and visible to the Tyranid Prime. Models in the selected unit gain the Precision ability for attacks made against that model's unit.
  • Adaptive Reflexes: gain the Unyielding ability.

sections.prose:
Psychic Terror [Psychic]: While this model is on the battlefield, enemy Psyker models taking Battle Shock tests caused by the Shadow in the Warp ability Reduce their Leadership characteristic to 9+ for those Battle Shock tests.

Mind Control [Psychic]: While this model is on the battlefield, it can attempt to use this ability when it is activated instead of making a Ranged attack as part of a Shoot Action. To do so, select 1 enemy Psyker model visible to and within 24" of this model as the target of this ability and roll a D6. The result of the D6 roll leads to 1 of the following to occur:

  • Roll of 1-2 - Psychic Will Prevails: On a roll of a 1 or 2, the enemy's psychic will prevails, and this model immediately suffers D3 Mortal Wounds
  • Roll of 3-4 - Self-Inflicted Wounds: On a roll of a 3 or 4, the Neurotyrant successfully controls the mind of the enemy psyker to the point of causing self-harm. The enemy Psyker immediately suffers D3+1 Mortal Wounds.
  • Roll of a 5-6 or above - Total Control: One a roll of a 5 or 6, the Neurotyrant successfully controls the mind of the Psyker and forces them to release a Psychic Attack on a friendly unit. Select 1 enemy unit to be the target of 1 of the enemy Psyker's Psychic Attacks. The opposing player then completes that attack as normal.

Tunnel Borer: After this model arrives from the battlefield using its Deep Strike ability, mark the location of the battlefield where it did so. This marks the opening of the tunnel bored by this model and is referred to as the Tunnel Opening Marker. Tyranids Beast units held in strategic reserves that do not possess the Deep Strike ability can be placed on the battlefield within 6" of the Tunnel Opening Marker when using the Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves Action.

Blow That Hole!: Enemy Infantry models equipped with Grenade weapons can attempt to destroy the Tunnel Opening Marker. To do so, the unit allocates at least 1 attack with a Grenade at the marker. For each attack made, roll 1 D6. On a roll of a 4+ the Tunnel Opening Marker is destroyed and removed from the battlefield, and the Tunnel Borer ability cannot be used in that area for the remainder of the battle.

Feeding Frenzy: Each model in this unit can use this ability once per Battle Round. To do so, when the model successfully destroys models from an enemy unit, it can attempt a Feeding Frenzy by rolling a D6. On a 3+, the Feeding Frenzy begins as follows:

  • If the majority of the models in the unit are Toughness 2 or lower, the unit suffers D6+1 Mortal Wounds
  • If the majority of the models in the unit are Toughness 3, the unit suffers D3+3 Mortal Wounds
  • If the majority of the models in the unit are Toughness 4 or 5, the unit suffers D3 Mortal Wounds

This ability has no effect on units where the majority of the models in the unit are Toughness 6 or higher.
